dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing of the 2D profile from the widest mid-body section towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None visible; lateral margins where skin meets water appear smooth and devoid of localized structural bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel values across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple light-colored, low-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) on the mid-to-posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear scratches or rake marks visible across the mid-dorsal surface, appearing lighter than the baseline skin tone.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a distinct, dark, high-contrast oval aperture on the anterior dorsal midline.
